description:
Connect ChatGPT to Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising, GA4 and 200+ marketing sources with Supermetrics — to both analyze your data and take action on your campaigns.

Beyond reporting, you can create, edit and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Microsoft Advertising directly from chat — adjust budgets and bids, pause or launch campaigns, update targeting and manage creatives.

The Supermetrics MCP server gives secure, real-time access so you can ask for things like:

 - "How did our Google Ads campaigns perform last month vs the month before?"
 - "Pause every campaign with a cost per conversion above €50."
 - "Reallocate budget to my highest-performing campaigns."
 - "Launch a new Meta campaign targeting our retargeting audience."
 - "Compare cost per conversion across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn this quarter."
 - "Which campaigns are wasting spend right now — and cut their budgets 20%."
 
Works with the ad, analytics, CRM and e-commerce platforms your team already uses, including Google Search Console, Shopify, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Salesforce, Amazon Ads, Pinterest, Snapchat and Reddit Ads.
 
Built on Supermetrics' trusted data infrastructure, this integration ensures accurate, governed, and up-to-date marketing data — and safe, controlled campaign changes — inside ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Which data sources can I connect to?
How did my Google Ads campaign perform last month?
Analyze marketing performance across our main ad networks
